display_name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
credits: (IGCS shared UE5 pool, raptoravis UUU 5.8.11 catalog)
notes: Oblivion Remastered's 2 per-game keys in the catalog are atmospheric-write hooks (not camera write); the actual camera intercept comes from the shared UE5 pool's AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1. Bethesda title, mod-friendly, no anti-cheat.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_sse
intercepts.description: AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (shared UE5 pool, SSE variant) - field-by-field MOV block copying FMinimalViewInfo from rdx to rcx.

capture._capture_note: UE5 reversed-Z. Open-world Cyrodiil with deep horizon -> log curve essential.

camera_write_profile._comment: Standard UE5 FMinimalViewInfo at rdx. Location FVector3d (3 doubles) at 0x00, Rotation FRotator (3 floats) at 0x18, FOV at 0x24. Verify offsets after Capture if values look wrong.
